status.en: 15 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 67% more than the week before, most of them in Kivu, Kinshasa and Kigali.
status.nb: 15 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 67 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Kivu, Kinshasa og Kigali.

summary.en: M23 rebels have seized a major town in eastern DRC, breaking a ceasefire and intensifying fighting with the Congolese army, while ADF gunmen continue killing civilians in Ituri province. A drone strike hit Bunyakiri hospital, forcing MSF to relocate 76 patients. Rwanda’s foreign minister says the US has an unbalanced approach as the US imposes sanctions on Rwanda for alleged support to rebels. Direct Relief delivered 53 tons of medical aid to combat the record Ebola outbreak, and the FRN-M23 rebels announced a plan to build 3,300 houses to ease the Goma housing crisis. 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: M23‑opprørerne har tatt kontroll over en større by i østlige DRC, brutt en våpenhvile og forsterket kampene med den kongolesiske hæren, mens ADF-våpnere fortsetter å drepe sivile i Ituri-provinsen. Et droneangrep traff Bunyakiri-sykehuset, og MSF måtte flytte 76 pasienter. Rwandas utenriksminister sier USA har en ubalansert tilnærming ettersom USA innfører sanksjoner mot Rwanda for påstått støtte til opprørerne. Direct Relief leverte 53 tonn medisinsk hjelp for å bekjempe den rekordstore ebolautbruddet, og FRN-M23‑opprørerne kunngjorde en plan om å bygge 3 300 hus for å lindre boligmangelen i Goma. 1 158 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
